recommendation.rationale: These gifts let Felix explore the stars he loves while keeping hands busy and imagination soaring. wish.text: Dear Felix, at nine years old your curiosity about the stars shines brighter than ever. I’ve left a little magic that lets you gaze through the heavens, watch constellations glow on your ceiling, and piece together your own sparkling solar system. May your nights be filled with wonder and discovery. Merry Christmas!
